title: ELIMFILTERS Cartridge Filters — Top Cap Printing Standard

cylindricalBothEnds.rule: When the cartridge has equivalent cylindrical end caps and no dedicated lower information area, repeat the same approved circular artwork on both ends.

ink.name: ELIMFILTERS Neutral Grey
ink.note: Pantone is a production communication reference; final acceptance must be against the approved physical print sample.

hydrocoreApplicationRule.requirement: The SKU prefix and printed Product Type must always match the actual application. HYDROCORE remains the technology mark for both approved applications.

manufacturingControls: Use only master logos from frontend/public/assets/.
Do not redraw, typeset, stretch or approximate the ELIMFILTERS or technology logos.
Keep all printed information inside the usable annular print area and clear of the center hole and cap edge.
Artwork must follow the circular geometry of the approved reference cap; the ELIMFILTERS logo is not to be placed as a straight rectangular lockup on this cylindrical-cap design.
Media remains unprinted and carries no adhesive label.
Mass production requires approval of a physical Golden Sample.
